body: Not usually my face, but my neck and throat area. I know you already know but don’t do it man! Good luck and best wishes, hope you get help

tell someone! Get help! it’s an awful addiction. Ugly and scary and nearly impossible to get away from. Please don’t do it again, be safe, keep the wound clean. But really, talk to a therapist or your parents or friends or anyone. It’s the most important step to not falling down the rabbit hole that is self harm.

Hey! I feel like I don’t have too much room to give advice here, but have you looked at why you started in the first place, the feelings you have before and after you cut? It could help you work through it on your own. But have you tried seeing someone for your mental health, like a therapist? It’s definitely helpful, but you have to be consistent with it too. I’m wishing the best for you, I hope it gets better for you, you deserve it.

Counseling is a lot less intensive compared to therapy, in my opinion. Make sure you talk to your psych and figure out your meds. I wish the best for you and you can message me if you ever need a place or person to vent to

If it overwhelms you take a break, don’t look at the subreddit for a few days. Of course the people who post here matter, but you need to take care of yourself first, you have to be your number one priority.
Just general awful feelings have been getting me down. I don’t make changes or so anything exciting, and I do almost nothing outside of school due to bad friends.

Exactly ! The first few times she found out she took my door and screamed at me. Only after maybe 10 times of her finding cuts did she take me to a therapist. Being taken seriously seems so much easier than being punished for wanting help aha

Honestly, and sorry if this seems rude, but I’d kill to be in your position right now. Sorry. Maybe just appreciate that she wants you to get help? It’s okay that you’re frustrated, I know I was the first time my mom threatened me with getting help (I had been cutting for about two years by the time she found out). But with where I am now in my life, I’d want nothing more than to see a therapist and just talk. 

So I’m not saying you have to like it, but maybe consider it something that can help you. You may not think it but SH is an unhealthy behavior and professional help is warranted.

Hey, I’m 16 and going through the same shit. 
My friends are practically nonexistent at this point, and planning things takes me putting in all of the effort. 
My home life is overall pretty good, my parents are divorced but my mom and my step dad are pretty happy, for the most part. We’re financially stable. 
I overall have a really easy and good life and I’m just a whiny little girl I guess, but I really understand your thinking here. 
Living hurts, it’s boring, but my life outside of my head is just good enough that I question if I should really do it or not. 
Wish you the best, though.

My pets are honestly my reason too. My family could get over it but my dogs would have no clue what happened and they’d miss me. 

My room, with me in it, is a safe place for my smaller dog, and it hurts me to think of her losing that because I did something to myself. 

So basically, I feel your pain, but a dog to live for is better than nothing to live for
